referents.why: implied 'you' of 'say to Aaron': Yahweh commands Moses (w4) to tell Aaron. The builder's Aaron is wrong: the one told to speak is Moses.
implied 'you' of 'stretch out': the quoted command is for Aaron, the addressee of the relayed words.
referents.category: implied subject inside a quoted command

referents.why: implied 'you' of 'bring up the frogs': Aaron, as in the command before.
referents.category: implied subject inside a quoted command

links.why: plain waw joining two commands ('stretch out ... and cause the frogs to come up') in one imperative group.
the saying clause 'he said' introduces the command 'tell Aaron' (R1).
'tell Aaron' introduces what is said: the collection of commands (R1).

groups.why: outer speech of Yahweh to Moses; its part is the commanded turn Moses speaks to Aaron (R2).
the commanded speech: Moses is the one commanded to speak, so he is the sender (R2).
innermost turn: Yahweh's words quoted by Moses; its sender is the one quoted (R2).
two commands joined by waw are one imperative group with two command members.
